start: Owner of a gym with 2 or more branches, online, any panel page

steps.action: At the top of the panel open the Branch list and pick "All branches"
user_sees: Page title "All branches" with "<business name> · <n> branches"
"Loading every branch…" while the other branches are read
must_not: Only the open branch's numbers in the totals without a word
The page switches the open branch

steps.action: Read the six tiles and the "Each branch" card
user_sees: Tiles "Active members", "Money in this month" (with "₹… today"), "Fees due" ("<n> people owe"), "Came in today", "Plans ending in 7 days", "Joined this month"
One row per branch: "<n> active · <n> ending in 7 days · <n> came in today" and "₹… this month · ₹… due"; the open one has the pill "Open now"
must_not: Totals that are not the sum of the branch rows
A visit by a member of branch A at branch B counted at branch A

steps.action: Under "Who to call, in every branch" tap the chip "Fees due"
user_sees: Members of every branch with "<branch> · <mobile> · ₹… due", biggest amount first
"And <n> more. Open a branch to see its full list." when over 60
must_not: A member with nothing due on the list
The count in "And <n> more" wrong

steps.action: Under "Find a member in any branch" type 3 or more letters of a name in "Name or mobile number"
user_sees: Matching members of every branch with their branch name
"Can train at every branch" for an all-branch member
must_not: Archived members shown
Results from only the open branch

steps.action: Tap "Open" on one member of another branch
user_sees: "Opening…" style busy buttons, then that branch's panel on the member's page
must_not: The member page of a different member
Two branches opened at once after a second tap

start: Owner of a gym with 2 or more branches, on a phone, on More

steps.action: On More tap "All branches" ("Totals and lists from every branch")
user_sees: The same "All branches" page
must_not: The row shown to an owner of a one-branch gym

steps.action: In "Each branch" tap "Open" on another branch
user_sees: "Opening…" on that row, then that branch's Today page
must_not: The other rows' Open buttons still pressable while opening

steps.action: Open the Branch list at the top again and pick "All branches"
user_sees: The page again, now with "Open now" on the branch just opened
must_not: "Open now" still on the old branch

start: Owner of a gym with one branch types /branches in the address bar

user_sees: Title "All branches" and an empty state "One branch": "Your gym has one branch. Add another in Settings → Branches. Then this page shows every branch together."
must_not: A spinner that never ends
Zero tiles shown as if the gym had no members

steps.action: (Gym with branches) type 2 letters in "Name or mobile number", then a name nobody has
user_sees: Nothing below the box for 2 letters
"No member with that name or number." for the unknown name
must_not: "No member" shown after only 1 or 2 letters

start: Owner with 3 branches; one branch cannot be read (its key was signed out and a new one is refused, or the internet drops)

user_sees: A red banner "<branch>: <reason> Its numbers are not in the totals below. Tap “Refresh” to try again."
The tiles and rows for the branches that did load
must_not: The failed branch counted as zero without the banner
The whole page blank because one branch failed

user_sees: A red banner with the reason, still on All branches
must_not: The panel stuck on a half-opened branch
The device signed out

start: All branches open; a payment is then saved in another branch on another device

user_sees: Every branch read again; "Money in this month" and that branch's row go up by the payment
must_not: The old figure kept for a branch opened earlier this visit

steps.action: Switch to that branch with "Open", then come back to "All branches"
user_sees: "Open now" on the branch now open; the same totals
must_not: A branch counted twice (as the open one and as another)

steps.action: The payment is voided in that branch, then Refresh
user_sees: "Money in this month" goes down by that amount
must_not: A voided payment still counted

start: Owner of a gym with branches; a front-desk person is signed in on the desk laptop

steps.action: The desk person opens the panel and looks for All branches
user_sees: Only the gym's name at the top, no Branch list; no "All branches" on More
must_not: Money totals of any branch shown to the desk
Members' mobiles of other branches shown to the desk

user_sees: Members of every branch with their mobile numbers, for the owner only
must_not: Members of another business's gym in the lists
